context: Two teens chat about a busy school day at the bus stop
purpose: Teach: 諸君/あっさり/直ちに/あふれ/欠け/しかた/或いは/何事

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと聞いてよ、今日もう何事？って感じの一日だったんだけど。
lines.en: Listen, today was seriously a 'what is going on?' kind of day.
lines.style: Casual teen vent with exasperated rising tone and natural sentence-end softener

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかるー、廊下も人であふれてて、なかなか進まないし遅刻寸前だったよマジで。
lines.en: Totally, the halls were packed and barely moving, almost late for real.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen agreement with stretched vowels and quick rhythmic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 数学の小テスト、自信あったのに或いは計算ミスったかもって不安で、集中力に欠けてた感じ。
lines.en: I felt okay about the math quiz but maybe I miscalculated, kinda lost focus.
lines.style: Worried teen second-guessing herself with soft trailing self-doubt

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺もだよ、英語のスピーチあっさり終わって逆に不安なんだけど何これ。
lines.en: Same, my English speech ended way too easily, now I'm weirdly anxious.
lines.style: Self-deprecating teen humor with light shrug and rising end question

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活の方はどう？先輩、しかたなく新メンバー入れるって言ってたよね確か。
lines.en: How about your club? Senior said they'd reluctantly take new members, right?
lines.style: Curious teen redirecting topic with friendly inquisitive lift and confirming tail

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そうそう、キャプテンが「諸君、よろしく頼む」って急に言い出して、めっちゃウケた。
lines.en: Yeah, the captain suddenly said 'gentlemen, regards' old-school, we cracked up.
lines.style: Amused teen recounting with chuckling between phrases and quoted imitation voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ウケる、そういうノリ嫌いじゃないけどね、なんか部活っぽくて。
lines.en: Lol, I don't hate that kind of vibe though, feels very club-like.
lines.style: Light laughing teen with warm casual approval and trailing soft observation

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あ、バス来た！直ちに乗れって電光掲示板に出てるみたいに急がないと座席ないぞ。
lines.en: Oh, the bus! Move now or no seats, like the sign is yelling at us.
lines.style: Urgent teen voice rising with sudden movement and playful mock-announcement
